snippet.title: Poor Trader becomes RICH in 100 days
snippet.description:
What if you combined Oregon Trail with RimWorld?  Well you get this game: "Tradesman: Deal to Dealer", and according to steam reviews it is BRUTAL (I agree)!

0:00 Day 0-6 
0:24:35 Days 7-10 (First Epic)
0:41:15 Days 11-18 (First Caravan Raid)
1:00:05 Days 19-45 (The Undertaker gives more loot)
1:13:57 Days 46-54 (Kingpig Jack)
1:17:50 Days 55-81 (Sir Eggy, First Legendary)
1:25:35 Days 82-95 (Second Legendary Barbar the Barbarian)
1:34:33 Days 96-102 (Its Shwarmin' Time)
1:36:46 Days 102-113(Third Legendary Neurobard Fofan) 
1:40:05 Days 113-123(Fourth Legendary Dijoy the Vagabond, Ghost Hunter)
1:44:30 (Final Boss, The Throatcrusher)
